summary: Comprehensive Cosma CLI reference distilled from 4 official Cosma pages: User Manual, Getting Started, Changelog, and Now/Next. Covers all commands, full configuration template, Markdown/CSV content formats, record creation modes, modelize options, citations/bibliographies, cosmoscope UI and shortcuts, sharing tips, v2.6/2.5/2.4/2.1 changelog highlights, and the current roadmap (Nov 2025). Tailored for the Ecosistema Fintech Global project.
